summary: Cover unit (封面) is a terminal whole-unit school cover layout. It contains the university/document-type/title placeholders, the five basic-information lines, the location, and the submission date. The preceding 附件1 封面基本格式 paragraph is a style preamble and is captured as style_only, not as a fillable or retained content part. Each cover label line is decomposed into its fixed_label, style_only, and fill_slot spans; format instruction lines (in parentheses) are pure style_only obligations for the harness/style contract. Two adjacent values are kept separate where the vocabulary supplies distinct fields (advisor.name.zh vs advisor.title). author.student_id, author.cohort_class, author.department, and submission.date lines bind the entire line as a single fill slot because each line carries one semantic value behind one label; this aligns with the pre-input field vocabulary's allowed_part_roles.

parts.text: 附件1 封面基本格式：单倍行距；上下页边距均为2.54厘米，左右页边距均为2.6厘米；除基本信息的5行内容外，其余内容均居中。“□” 表示占1个字宽（即2个字符）的空格。所做的为论文,则标题中设计不要；所做的为设计,则标题中论文不要。

semantic_judgments.reason: Pre-cover 封面基本格式 preamble outside the visible cover layout (per the accepted unit-boundary checkpoint). It specifies page margins, line spacing, the alignment rule (everything except the 5 basic-info lines is centered), the □ width marker, and the 论文/设计 title-condensation rule. These are format/style obligations for the cover; they belong to the style contract, not to retained or fillable content.
Format instruction setting the font and spacing for the university-name line below. Pure style obligation.

parts.text: 湖 南 农 业 大学（一号华文行楷加粗）

semantic_judgments.reason: University name is fixed school branding; characters are rendered with single-char spacing per school style. The parenthetical font requirement is style context only and does not bind a field.

parts.text: 全日制普通本科生毕业论文(设计)（一号黑体加粗）

semantic_judgments.reason: Fixed document-type heading for the cover. Per the preamble 论文/设计 condensation rule, the active word will be rendered without the other; the conditional form remains the school's fixed document-type label rather than a fill slot. The parenthetical font hint is style context.
Format instruction for spacing before the Chinese title. Pure style obligation.

parts.text: 毕业论文（设计）中文题目 （小二黑体加粗）

semantic_judgments.reason: The visible Chinese-title placeholder phrase is itself a fixed cover label; the actual thesis title value is supplied via the thesis.title.zh fill slot elsewhere in the cover binding. The parenthetical font hint is style context.

parts.text: TITLE OF GRADUATION PAPER（四号Times New Roman加粗，大写）

semantic_judgments.reason: The visible English-title placeholder phrase is itself a fixed cover label; the actual English thesis title value is supplied via the thesis.title.en fill slot. The parenthetical font specification is style context.

parts.text: （根据题目长短四号字空二或三行）

semantic_judgments.reason: Format instruction adjusting spacing below the title block based on title length. Pure style obligation.

Basic-info line 1: 学生姓名 and the colon are the fixed label; (三号黑体加粗) is a font requirement for the label; the ××× (or ×□×) placeholder is the author.name.zh fill slot; (三号楷体加粗) is a font requirement for the value. author.name.zh.allowed_part_roles includes fill_slot.
Basic-info line 2: the entire line carries one semantic value (student number) behind one label (学号), so it binds as a single fill_slot for author.student_id. Leading □□□□□□ is layout spacing.
Basic-info line 3: per the field vocabulary, the school merges 年级/专业/班级 into one composite value (author.cohort_class). The entire line binds as a single fill_slot for that composite field.

Basic-info line 4 carries two distinct adjacent values (name and rank) governed by two distinct fields; both are split out as fill_slots. The separating □ between name and rank is fixed layout. advisor.name.zh and advisor.title both have allowed_part_roles including fill_slot.

Basic-info line 5: the ××××学院 placeholder is the author.department fill slot; the leading □□□□□□ is layout spacing; the trailing (学院名用全称) is a fixed-content rule for the value (style_only) — does not bind a field.
Format instruction adjusting spacing before the location/date block. Pure style obligation.
Fixed school location label; the parenthetical font specification is style context only.
Cover submission date: the entire line carries one semantic value (submission date) behind one label (提交日期), so it binds as a single fill_slot for submission.date.
